title: AI agents trading my $20k on Robinhood: up 1.18% today
author: Unfair_Set_355
selftext:
Robinhood: $20,985.50, up $244.20 (up 1.18%)

Raijin book with Kalshi and Coinbase: $22,080.09, up $265.25 (up 1.22%)

No manual trades. Quick rundown:

\- FAANG+ Momentum, up $57.86: sold all its NVDA at the open and moved into Amazon and Google  
\- Pelosi Tracker, up $50.59: followed Pelosi's latest filing into Apple, Amazon, Google and NVDA  
\- AI Picks & Shovels, up 5.03%: bought Micron about 16% cheaper than it did a month ago  
\- First of the Month, up 1.90%: went 3x leveraged on the S&P for its end of month window  
\- Business As Usual, up $18.85: it only uses leverage on normal weather days in New York, so today it just held the S&P  
\- Dip Buyer, up 0.32%: only buys on dip days, so about half its money is still in cash, which holds the total percent back on green days like this  
\- Trump Tweet Trader, down $8.81: the one real red day

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: the one I keep coming back to on these updates is First of the Month going 3x on the S&P. that agent makes the book's day, up or down, and a 1.18% day with a 3x leg in it is mostly that leg. that was the whole point when I built Quantradin: each agent on its own paper book, free, so a 3x one cannot hide inside the total. quantradin.com. which agent is up most since the $10k start?

comments.author: Michael_Bennett24323
comments.body: A green day is encouraging but one day doesn’t tell you much about how these strategies perform over time. I’d track returns against a simple benchmark and factor in fees, drawdowns and leverage risk before deciding which agents are actually adding value.
